function.name: Terrain_InstallQueryCallbacks
behavior: Reads three longwords from the caller's A0 record.
Publishes them to TERRAIN_QUERY_CALLBACK_A/B/C at FF7DD2, FF7DD6, and FF7DDA.

conclusion: Terrain query callback installation is a direct three-pointer publication service, separate from the paired VDP word setup helper at 0x001B32F0.
